contracts.authority: Go module proxy protocol (go.dev/ref/mod#goproxy-protocol) and the go-import meta tag of a remote import path (go.dev/ref/mod#vcs-find)
contracts.reason: Asks the @latest endpoint of the module proxies GOPROXY names, or of the module origin a go-import mod tag names, for the go.putnami.dev/app version a scaffolded project pins, as the go command does. The wire contract belongs to the Go module proxy protocol, so no Putnami provider declaration can generate this client.

contracts.authority: go.dev release index and the GitHub REST releases API (docs.github.com/rest/releases)
contracts.reason: Reads the published Go and Bun toolchain releases the lock pins.

contracts.authority: Putnami platform endpoints (protocols/platform: /readyz, /version) and the putnami.http-routes.v1 routes of the workload under qualification, reached at the base URL the user names with --target
contracts.reason: `putnami qualify` smoke-tests whatever deployment the user names: the platform surface is a protocol every runtime serves, and the requests are derived from that workload's own route inventory, so no provider declaration can generate one client for every qualified workload.

contracts.authority: OpenTelemetry OTLP/HTTP v1 (opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otlp), mirrored by protocols/telemetry
contracts.reason: Exports CLI usage records over OTLP/HTTP. The wire contract belongs to OpenTelemetry, so no Putnami provider declaration can generate this client.
